project-s.space.text: Project-S Munich-based space safety and orbital intelligence startup developing space-based radar payloads, AI-enabled orbital intelligence software, and robotic debris removal technology for space traffic management and satellite collision avoidance.

heylogin.com.text: heylogin heylogin is a Germany-based B2B password manager offering a hardware-based, passwordless login using end-to-end encryption and 2-factor security by default, developed and hosted in Germany with GDPR compliance.

fin.com.text: Fin.com Fin.com is a US (New York-based) payments infrastructure company providing a unified orchestration layer for cross-border money movement, combining local payment rails, USD virtual accounts, SWIFT, and stablecoin settlement.

useaiir.com.text: Aiir An AI platform for investor relations at asset managers, automating investor due diligence (DDQs, ESGs, ODDs), answer bank management, performance reporting, and LP requests.

empirik.ai.text: Empirik Empirik is an AI infrastructure reliability/observability platform, an 'autonomous infrastructure engineer' that tracks system changes and infers their ripple effects across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments to predict and prevent outages before they happen.

gaiadynamics.ai.text: Gaia Dynamics Gaia Dynamics is an AI-powered trade compliance platform that helps importers, exporters, logistics providers, customs brokerages, consultants, and law firms verify trade data, manage compliance workflows, and evaluate opportunities across global trade.

scrolled.org.text: ScrollEd A Palo Alto-based startup that has built an app converting textbooks, PDFs and other text files into a short-form, vertical scrolling feed of AI-generated video, audio, text and quizzes, aimed at students, educational institutions and corporate training programs.

typesafe.ai.text: TypeSafe AI TypeSafe AI is an AI lab building machine-native, composable intelligence designed to be integrated directly into software systems as a reliable, efficient computing primitive rather than a conversational assistant, with its first model called Jev.

sunzu.com.text: Sunzu Sunzu is an AI user research platform that lets product teams run synthetic depth interviews, concept tests, UX tests and ad tests to get user insights in minutes, via a web app or an MCP integration for AI assistants.
